Commentary.Commentary: Finally, a date with destiny has been fixed by Australia! Life has come full circle for this team, as the final of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup will be the same as the first match of the tournament. The hosts were beaten then by India but will be looking to exact revenge on the most important day of all. Do join us for what promises to be an exhilarating contest at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. The match will start at 1800 Local (0700 GMT) on Sunday, 8th March 2020. Till then, cheers and take care!

Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, says that it was extremely tense and even in the last couple of balls they're not safe. Adds that there were nerves in the last over and she is happy that they ended up with the win. Mentions that they had a good total without it being great. Adds that they needed to bowl really well to get the desired result. States that it is all about calming everyone down and adds that they have been really good after the first couple of games. Goes onto say that coming back after being three down early against Sri Lanka was a great effort. Tells that India are a class side and have been playing excellent cricket and Australia will have to play really well. Feels that they just need to enjoy the final.

South African skipper, Dane Van Niekerk, is looking very upset with the loss. Says that they felt good about the target but credits Australia for the way they bowled. Lauds her own bowlers also for pulling things back in the first innings. Shares that to come short every time is not easy and she is feeling really emotional looking at her girls. States that they are a talented bunch and praises Wolvaardt for her efforts down the order. Signs off with a little bit of smile as she says that South Africa is a great place for the next World Cup and everybody will thoroughly enjoy.

MEG LANNING IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her outstanding contribution with the bat! She says that the evening was very special and that the groundsmen did a terrific job. Further says that the wicket was very skiddy and the South African bowlers did really well. Again mentions about the groundsmen and their wonderful job so that a match could be possible even after such long and heavy showers in Sydney.

Soon after the completion of the first innings, the heavens opened up and the chase was reduced to 13 overs with South Africa needing 98 to win. Australia though were motivated and brought their best game on the field. The bowling was neat and tidy and it was superbly backed up by the fielders. Megan Schutt used all her experience and bowled crucial overs at both ends of the chase. After getting reduced to 24/3, Laura Wolvaardt and Sune Luus led a fightback with a handy partnership but once this stand was broken, Australia piled on the pressure and secured a win. Stay tuned for the presentation...

What a day this has been! First semi-final got completely washed out and the second one was also expected to suffer the same fate. Australia's chances of qualification were hanging by a thread and in case of a no-contest, South Africa would have gone through. But the weather cleared just in time for the home team. Put to bat, Australia started well but then lost the plot. The South African bowlers applied immense pressure but Meg Lanning stuck to her guns and played a vital knock to take Australia to a challenging total. Her stumping chance was missed when she was on 24 and in hindsight, that has cost South Africa big.

What a match! Australia have pulled it off! They fought the weather, they fought the South African team and have booked a date with India in the grand finale! Don't ever let the pressure exceed the pleasure. Spare a thought for South Africa though. Once again they have faltered under pressure of the knockouts. Tears in their camp, ecstasy in the Australian camp! Emotions pouring.
That is it! The Aussies win. Full delivery on middle, de Klerk sweeps it to the deep backward square leg region for just a run. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 5 RUNS (DLS METHOD) AND ENTER THE FINAL!

FOUR! Nicely played but she needed to hit a six to have a chance to make it to the semi-finals. Only an extra can save the Proteas though! Low full toss on middle, de Klerk paddles it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Laura flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Nadine wants the second but Wolvaardt sends her back.
Nicely played and well fielded too! Floated on middle, Wolvaardt whips it towards the deep mid-wicket region. Mooney comes across and dives to make an excellent stop. Two runs.
FOUR! Wolvaardt is keeping the Proteas in the game! Flighted ball outside off, Wolvaardt gets forward and then plays it over the point fielder for a boundary. 15 more needed from 4 balls.
Nadine de Klerk makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tryon departs now and Lanning takes the catch. A full toss outside off, Tryon looks to hit it hard on the off side but does not get the full connection that she would have wanted. The ball lobs towards extra cover where Meg Lanning makes no mistake and takes an easy catch to her right.
19 needed off 6 balls! Who will bowl the pressure over? Meg Lanning has plenty of options. She has entrusted Jess Jonassen to do the job.

SIX! Whacked! South Africa desperately needed this! Schutt dishes a full ball on middle. Wolvaardt stands in her crease and then whacks it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie. 19 runs required from the last over. Will we see a Super Over?
Well bowled! Slower ball on middle, Wolvaardt moves forward and then just drives it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on off, Tryon pushes it to long off for a single.
Full on middle, Wolvaardt drives it uppishly past the bowler and towards long on for just a single.
Chloe Tryon is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Beth Mooney takes the catch and Luus has to walk back now! Australia surely on top! A slower ball outside off, Luus looks to go over long off for a biggie but mistimes it. The ball lobs towards long off and Mooney takes an easy catch. A huge setback for the Proteas at a crucial juncture.
Schutt starts wonderfully! Luus looks to shuffle to the off side and paddle but Schutt bowls a yorker and Luus misses her shot.
Megan Schutt to bowl the all-important penultimate over.
Excellent delivery to finish! Yorker outside off, Wolvaardt looks to dig it out but fails to get any bat on it. 27 required from the last two overs.
Slower short ball outside off, Luus pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Short ball on middle, Wolvaardt pulls it to long on for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Wolvaardt looks to heave it away but misses to get any bat on it.

DROPPED! Terrific attempt though. This is not an easy chance. Full toss on off, Wolvaardt hammers it straight back. Kimmince gets her right hand on her followthrough but fails to hold on. Saved a certain boundary there. The ball rolls towards long on and the batters pick up a couple.
Full delivery outside off, Luus drives it to the off side for a single.
Delissa Kimmince to continue. Can she keep it tight and pull the game in Australia's favour?
Length ball outside off, Wolvaardt punches it to point. We have a game as 10 overs have been completed. 32 required from the last three overs.
Full toss on middle, Luus works it to long on and crosses over for a couple.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Wolvaardt and this one is an even better shot! Wolvaardt looks to make room and play this one towards the off side. Carey follows her but Wolvaardt still manages to loft this one over the fielder at extra cover and fetches a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Wolvaardt has played that superbly. Full ball on off, Wolvaardt has lofted that over the fielder at mid off for a boundary.
Another full ball on middle, this time Luus jams it out towards long on and gets a single.
Carey bowls a full ball on the middle pole line, the batter makes room and digs this out towards mid off.
Nicola Carey (1-0-4-0) to bowl again. Six more balls to constitute a game.

DROPPED! Jess Jonassen drops a tough chance! Good length ball outside off, Luus lifts it towards mid off but does not get the required elevation on it. Jess flies to her left at the edge of the circle but fails to hold on. The ball rolls to long off and the batters pick up a single. 8 from the over!
FOUR! Excellent from Luus! Fullish on off, Luus smashes it over the mid off fielder and finds the fence behind.
How did she get any bat on it? Yorker on the pads, Luus looks to flick but gets an inside edge on it. The ball rolls to fine leg and the batters pick up only a single.
Very good bowling! Kimmince bowls a very full ball on middle, Wolvaardt makes room but can only dig it out towards covers.
Full on middle, Luus whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on the pads, Wolvaardt works it to long on for a single.
Delissa Kimmince is back on. 1-0-3-1 are her figures, so far.
Outside off, punched to cover. Good over for South Africa. 12 runs from it. 51 more required from 5 overs.
Floated on middle, Laura works it to the deep square leg region for a single.
SIX! This is turning out to be a good over for the Proteas. Tossed up ball outside off, Wolvaardt powers it over the long on region for a biggie.
Flatter one outside off, Luus punches it to the cover region.
Floated on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! South Africa need more of these! Floated on middle, Luus lunges and lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. 59 more from 35 balls.
Jess Jonassen (1-0-3-0) is back on.
Full delivery on middle, Wolvaardt makes room and looks to drive. She times it well but finds the mid off fielder. 63 needed in the last 6 overs.
Good length ball on middle, Luus flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, Wolvaardt pushes it past the bowler where the mid on fielder dives to make the stop. A single taken.
Full delivery on off, Wolvaardt looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Good length ball on off, Luus pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Full ball on off, driven towards cover for a single.
Short ball on off, Wolvaardt looks to pull but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads. Choking the flow of runs completely. Massive pressure building on the Proteas!
Flatter one outside off, Laura punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
Nothing from the Free Hit! Full on middle, Wolvaardt flicks it to mid-wicket, finds the fielder.
NO BALL! Flighted ball on middle, Luus sweeps it to deep square leg and takes a single. The third umpire has signaled it as a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit to follow...
Looped up ball outside off, Luus drives it uppishly towards wide of long off. The fielder comes across and cleans it up. Two taken.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Luus looks to drive off the front foot but fails to get any bat on it. The keeper whips the bails off but the batter was in.
Flatter one outside off, Luus punches it to the off side.
Sophie Molineuz is back on. 1-0-11-1, her figures so far.
Good length ball outside off, Laura punches it to the deep point region for a couple.
Laura Wolvaardt is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch from Meg Lanning! South Africa are crumbling under pressure! Full delivery outside off, du Preez looks to drive but does so uppishly. It goes towards Lanning at cover who dives forward and takes an excellent catch inches above the surface. South Africa in desperate need of a partnership.
Full on middle, du Preez defends it to the mid on region.
On middle, Mignon defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball way outside off, du Preez cuts but finds the point fielder. She will feel that she missed out here.
Good length ball on the pads, Luus flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Delissa Kimmince is into the attack.
Mignon du Preez is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Megan Schutt has struck gold here as Van Niekerk, the South African skipper, departs. Good length ball around the off pole line, it pitches and moves in with movement off the surface. Van Niekerk looks to rock back and block it out but is completely bamboozled by the movement and the stumps behind are shattered. The Powerplay ends on a positive note for Australia as South Africa are 23/2.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Just over! Good length ball on off, Van Niekerk just about manages to get this one over the fielder at mid off and the batters get a couple.
Full ball on off, swinging in, driven towards the fielder at cover.
On the pads now, flicked towards square leg for a single and Luus is off the mark.
Length delivery outside off, cut towards point where the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Megan Schutt is back into the attack now. Gave away 6 runs in her opening over.
Good length ball outside off, Van Niekerk pushes it to the cover region. Good over from Molineux. She gave away some runs but picked up the all-important wicket of Lizelle Lee.
Sune Luus is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lee falls and Molineux does the trick in her first over! Australia need to keep picking wickets though! Flighted ball on off, Lee goes on her knees and then looks to smash it out of the ground but it takes the top edge and flies towards wide long on. Ashleigh Gardner moves to her right and takes a very good running catch. 78 runs required from 61 balls.
On off, punched to the off side.
FOUR! Beautiful batting from Lee. Floated outside off, Lee dances down and lifts it over the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Flatter one outside off, Van Niekerk punches it to covers and takes a single.

SIX! Welcome into the attack, Molineux! Flighted ball around off, Van Niekerk moves to her off side and then slog sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum. There was a fielder present but she just watches the ball sail over her head.
Sophie Molineux into the attack now.
Full on middle, Van Niekerk sweeps it to square leg where the fielder makes a good stop. Saved a boundary. A single. 89 needed off 66 balls!
Outside off, Dane punches it to cover.
Flatter one on middle, Van Niekerk pushes it back to the bowler.
UPPISH BUT SAFE! Tossed up on middle, Lee looks to lift it over long on but does not time it well. The ball goes on the bounce to the fielder and the batters take a single.
Floated on off, Lee prods forward and defends it out.
Jonassen starts with a floated ball on off, Dane drives it to long on for a single.
Jess Jonassen to bowl from the other end.
Good length ball on off, Lee defends it to the point region and takes a single. 6 from the first over.
FOUR! Nicely played! First boundary of the chase! Back of a length ball on middle, Lee pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, Van Niekerk flicks it to deep mid-wicket to get off the mark.
SOUTH AFRICA ARE UNDERWAY! Full on middle, Lee sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Lee moves to her off side and then looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. There is an appeal made for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Schutt starts with a short of a length ball on middle, Lee pulls it but straight to the short fine leg fielder.

Okay, the prayers by the Australian players and fans have been answered as play is about to resume. The revised target is 98 runs off 13 overs. The Powerplay will be of 4 overs. 3 bowlers can bowl a maximum of 3 overs and 2 bowlers can bowl a maximum of 2. The fielders have already taken their positions and the South African opening batters, skipper Dane Van Niekerk and Lizelle Lee are out on the field as well. Megan Schutt to start the proceedings for Australia. Finally, here we go...
